paragraphs: The pre-shift meeting assigns work and reviews safety. The supervisor walks the line, monitors takt time, and reallocates people when a machine slows. A midday shutdown requires coordination with maintenance. The afternoon brings quality investigation, rework, or isolation. Before leaving, the supervisor reconciles output and prepares an exception report.
In one sentence, they turn people and machines into output. They schedule and assign work, monitor takt time, manage quality and safety, resolve disruptions, coach workers, and review output.
